Package org.osgi.impl.service.jndi

Interface FactoryManager

All Superinterfaces:
InitialContextFactoryBuilder
public interface FactoryManager extends InitialContextFactoryBuilder
Interface that defines the basic usage of the Factory Manager in RFC 142. The FactoryManager interface can be used to abstract the details of OSGi service access from certain portions of RFC 142.

  • Method Details

    • getURLContextFactory

      ObjectFactory getURLContextFactory(String urlScheme)
      Returns a javax.naming.spi.ObjectFactory that is published in the OSGi service registry. The ObjectFactory returned must support the specified urlScheme.
      Parameters:
      urlScheme - the requested URL scheme
      Returns:
      a javax.naming.spi.ObjectFactory that supports the given URL scheme

    • associateFactoryService

      void associateFactoryService(Object factory, Context createdContext)
      Associates a given OSGi JNDI Factory service to a Context that was created with the given service.
      Parameters:
      factory - the JNDI factory service used to create the Context
      createdContext - the Context created with this factory service

    • isFactoryServiceActive

      boolean isFactoryServiceActive(Object factory)
      Checks to see if a given OSGi JNDI Factory Service is still active in the service registry.
      Parameters:
      factory - the JNDI Factory service
      Returns:
      true if the service is still available false if the service is no longer available
